Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer posts is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for a Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Eligibility includes retired teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwari workers, doctors, law students, and members of NGOs and self-help groups, provided they have good behavior.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Mandi. The link will be provided in the 'Important Links' section.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer position is on a contractual basis, offering a temporary engagement with the District Legal Services Authority Mandi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DLSA/MND/VLC&SC./2026-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is broad, including educated persons with good behavior, and specific categories like law students, retired professionals, and social workers.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 175001.

faq.question: Q10. How should I send the application form?
faq.answer: Completed application forms should be sent via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the official notification.
